questions.prompt: Name a kind of person the Qur'an says Allah loves.

answers.explanation: "Allah loves those who rely on Him (mutawakkilin)."

answers.canonical: Those who fight in His cause in rows
answers.explanation: "…as if they were a solid structure."

answers.canonical: Those who follow the Prophet ﷺ
answers.explanation: "If you love Allah, follow me — Allah will love you."

questions.prompt: Name something the Qur'an says will happen to the world when the Hour comes.

answers.explanation: "The mountains will be like wool, fluffed up."
"When the earth is shaken with its quake."

answers.canonical: The seas are set on fire

answers.explanation: "The Day people will be like scattered moths."

answers.canonical: The earth throws out its burdens

answers.explanation: "…and the sun and moon are joined."

answers.canonical: The sky rolled up like a scroll
answers.explanation: "The Day We fold the heaven like the folding of a scroll."

answers.canonical: Every nursing mother forgets her baby
answers.explanation: "Every nursing mother will be distracted from what she was nursing."
"That Day it will report its news."

questions.prompt: Name something from the life of Anas ibn Malik (RA).

answers.canonical: Served the Prophet ﷺ for ten years
answers.explanation: His mother gave him as a servant at about ten years old.

answers.canonical: "He never said to me, Why did you do that?"
answers.explanation: In ten years the Prophet ﷺ never scolded him.

answers.canonical: The Prophet's ﷺ du'a for him
answers.explanation: "O Allah, increase his wealth and children and bless him."
She brought him to the Prophet ﷺ.
He died in Basra around 93 AH.

answers.canonical: His garden bore fruit twice a year
answers.explanation: From the blessing of the du'a.

questions.prompt: Name an Arabic word for something in nature.
Name something Muslims are forbidden to eat or drink.

answers.explanation: "Forbidden to you are… the flesh of swine."
"Intoxicants… are filth from the work of Shaytan."

answers.canonical: Meat sacrificed to other than Allah
answers.explanation: "…and what has been dedicated to other than Allah."
"…and that from which a wild animal has eaten."
Every beast of prey with fangs.

Forbidden on the day of Khaybar.

bonus.prompt: Name something mentioned in Surah al-Waqi'ah.

answers.explanation: Those foremost, the people of the right, and the people of the left.
"The foremost, the foremost — they are the ones brought near."
"What are the companions of the right?"
"Have you seen what you emit — is it you who create it?"
"Have you seen the water you drink?"
"Have you seen the fire you kindle?"
"I swear by the setting of the stars."
"You will eat from the tree of zaqqum… and drink boiling water like thirsty camels."

bonus.prompt: Name someone the Hadith says Allah will not look at on the Day of Resurrection.

answers.canonical: One who drags his garment out of pride
variants: Garment below ankles out of pride
answers.explanation: "Allah will not look at one who drags his garment out of pride."

answers.canonical: One who reminds people of his favours
answers.explanation: Al-mannan — who reminds others of what he gave.

answers.canonical: One who sells with a false oath
answers.explanation: "…and one who sells his goods with a false oath."

answers.canonical: An old man who commits zina
answers.explanation: Among three Allah will not speak to or look at.
A poor man who is arrogant.

answers.canonical: One who withholds surplus water from travellers
answers.explanation: A man with extra water in the desert who refuses a traveller.
"Three Allah will not look at: one who disobeys his parents…"

answers.canonical: A man without protective jealousy for his family
answers.explanation: The dayyuth, in the same hadith.
